newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Advance Bank receives court approval.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Advance Bank receives court approval.

text.p: Advance Bank Australia Ltd said on Tuesday the Supreme Court of New South Wales had approved its planned capital reduction.
The reduction is part of its merger via scheme of arrangement with fellow regional bank, St George Bank Ltd.
The court confirmation follows Advance Bank shareholders' approval on Monday of the bank's plan to change its articles of association as a prelude to the merger with St George.
The change in the bank's articles allows a single shareholder to own more than 10 percent of the bank's shares.

Under the merger proposal, St George Bank is to offer Advance Bank ordinary shareholders 0.625 of a new St George Bank ordinary share, A$2.10 in cash from St George and a 20-cent per share special dividend for each Advance Bank share.
The special dividend would be franked to about 60 percent.
Advance Bank ordinary shareholders would also receive an interim fully franked dividend of 20 cents per share.
The offer values Advance at over A$2.6 billion.
